# Keyboard map

Generated from `KEYMAP` in `tools/v7/studio-ui.js` (the same table the player shows with F1). Every action is also a button on
screen; keys are an optional extra.

<!-- GENERATED:keys (mf docs-gen; do not edit by hand) -->
### Playback

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| Space | Play / pause |
| ← / → | Previous / next step (when nothing is selected) |
| Home / End | Start / end |
| [ / ] | Slower / faster |
| 2 / 3 / A | 2D plan / 3D / auto view (Studio closed) |

### Studio

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| F1 or ? | This keyboard map |
| Alt+1 … Alt+6 | Objects · Paths · Steps · Director · Numbers · Project |
| Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y | Undo / redo |
| Ctrl+S / Ctrl+Shift+S | Save the scene file / save as |
| Ctrl+O | Open a scene file (or drop it on the player) |
| Esc / V | Stop the tool, clear the selection |
| O | Ortho on / off (paths keep square legs) |
| G | Snap grid: off · 0.1 · 0.5 · 1 · 2 m |

### Objects

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| Click / drag | Select / move (Alt: no snap) |
| Green knob | Drag to turn (Shift: free angle) |
| Q / E | Turn 15° (Shift: 90°) |
| Arrows | Nudge one snap step (Shift: ×10) |
| + / − | Bigger / smaller |
| Ctrl+D | Duplicate |
| Delete | Delete |
| F | Fly to the selection |
| N | Place a new stop |
| P | Place the last object type again |

### Paths

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| S | Straighten the step (or every step at the selected stop) |
| Shift+S | Straighten the whole path |
| L | Make the step one L (one corner) |
| R / Shift+R | Auto-route the step / the whole path |
| B | Draw the step's path corner by corner (Enter ends) |
| PageUp / PageDown | Previous / next step |
| Double-click a leg | Add a corner |
| Right-click / Delete on a corner | Remove the corner |

### Director

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| K / Shift+K | Camera key here / key that rides with the trolley |
| J | Start / stop recording your camera move |
| C | Caption here |
| Shift+P | Watch the director cut from the start |

### Camera

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| Left drag | Orbit |
| Right drag or Shift+drag | Pan |
| Wheel | Zoom toward the cursor |
| Double-click | Fly to that point |
| Pad | Sticks, lens, speed, smooth, views, 6 shots (right-click a shot to save it) |
<!-- /GENERATED:keys -->
